purpose: Real-evaluation confirmation of surrogate-assisted LHFiD at the 150-evaluation budget. Fixed before any C2 job ran; launched because the pre-registered simulation (configs/nas/sa_simulation.json) met its decision rule.
existing_runs: random and nsga2 seeds 1-3 are the completed v3 searches in artifacts/nas (same code, protocol and calibration split)
new_runs: artifacts/nas_c2/seed{1..6}: each job measures its own reference first; seeds 1-3 run sa_lhfid and sa_nsga2, seeds 4-6 run all four arms; arm order rotated by seed
warm_start: none: every run starts from scratch
primary_indicator: exact 4-D hypervolume of all evaluated candidates with the pre-registered reference (CLIP 25.2, fidelity 75, 600 ms, 1,700 MB); latency normalized by the run's own job reference times the median reference over all jobs
robustness_indicators: same with GFLOPs in place of latency (reference 36,000 GFLOPs; drift-free)
3-D without CLIP: fidelity, latency, U-Net MB
test: two-sided Mann-Whitney U, sa_lhfid vs each other arm (6 vs 6 runs), Holm over the three comparisons on the primary indicator
claim_rule: sa_lhfid is claimed better than an arm if the primary test is Holm-significant and the median difference has the same sign on both robustness indicators
gpu: record each job's GPU model; latency enters only after per-job normalization
